description: This file contains unit tests for the DIDService component within the internal services of the agentfield control plane project. It tests registration, resolution, validation, differential analysis, registration updates, deregistration, and system enable/disable behavior related to decentralized identifiers (DIDs).

methods.name: setupDIDTestEnvironment
methods.description: Initializes and prepares the testing environment for DIDService tests, including storage setup, registry, keystore, and service initialization.

methods.name: TestDIDServiceRegisterAgentAndResolve
methods.description: Tests registering an agent and resolving its DID, including related reasoners and skills.

methods.name: TestDIDServiceValidateRegistryFailure
methods.description: Tests validation of the agent registry failure scenario.

methods.name: TestDIDService_ResolveDID_RootDID
methods.description: Tests resolving the root DID for a registered agent.

methods.name: TestDIDService_ResolveDID_NotFound
methods.description: Tests the behavior when resolving a DID that does not exist.

methods.name: TestDIDService_ResolveDID_DisabledSystem
methods.description: Ensures that resolving a DID when the system is disabled returns an error.

methods.name: TestDIDService_RegisterAgent_ExistingAgent_NoChanges
methods.description: Tests re-registering the same agent with no component changes.

methods.name: TestDIDService_PartialRegisterAgent_NewComponents
methods.description: Tests partial registration adding new reasoners and skills to an existing agent.

methods.name: TestDIDService_PartialRegisterAgent_DisabledSystem
methods.description: Verifies that partial registration fails when the system is disabled.

methods.name: TestDIDService_DeregisterComponents_Success
methods.description: Tests successful deregistration of specific components from an agent.

methods.name: TestDIDService_DeregisterComponents_NotFound
methods.description: Tests deregistration of components that do not exist.

methods.name: TestDIDService_DeregisterComponents_AgentNotFound
methods.description: Checks behavior when trying to deregister components from a non-existent agent.

methods.name: TestDIDService_PerformDifferentialAnalysis_NoChanges
methods.description: Tests differential analysis when no changes are needed.

methods.name: TestDIDService_PerformDifferentialAnalysis_NewComponents
methods.description: Tests differential analysis detecting new components to add.

methods.name: TestDIDService_PerformDifferentialAnalysis_RemovedComponents
methods.description: Tests differential analysis discovering components to remove.

methods.name: TestDIDService_PerformDifferentialAnalysis_AgentNotFound
methods.description: Check error handling when agent does not exist during differential analysis.

methods.name: TestDIDService_GetExistingAgentDID_Success
methods.description: Tests retrieving existing agent DID data successfully.

methods.name: TestDIDService_GetExistingAgentDID_NotFound
methods.description: Tests error handling when agent's DID data is not found.

methods.name: TestDIDService_GetExistingAgentDID_DisabledSystem
methods.description: Ensures error when system is disabled while retrieving agent DID.

methods.name: TestDIDService_ListAllAgentDIDs_Success
methods.description: Tests listing all agent DIDs successfully.

methods.name: TestDIDService_ListAllAgentDIDs_DisabledSystem
methods.description: Verifies error when listing all agent DIDs if the system is disabled.

methods.name: TestDIDService_RegisterAgent_EmptyReasonerID
methods.description: Checks registration skips empty reasoner IDs.

methods.name: TestDIDService_RegisterAgent_EmptySkillID
methods.description: Checks registration skips empty skill IDs.

methods.name: TestDIDService_RegisterAgent_DisabledSystem
methods.description: Verifies registration fails when the system is disabled.

methods.name: TestDIDService_GetAgentFieldServerID
methods.description: Tests retrieving the agent field server ID.

methods.name: TestDIDService_GetAgentFieldServerID_NotInitialized
methods.description: Tests error when retrieving server ID if not initialized.
